why: 1.0.5-beta: clearer Status page, every untranslated thing is listed

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.5-beta - Persian for WoW Forever.

New: the Status page is much clearer - the report comes first, in three steps, with how many untranslated things were found and of which kind. One box holds everything (untranslated texts and errors), one button selects it, then Ctrl+C and paste it at wowfarsi.ir/report
New: far more untranslated things are listed by themselves - quests we have no Persian for, quest texts and objectives, quests whose text changed, NPC and object names in objectives.
Updated for game build 1.60.1.71091 (from 1.0.4): Persian for the rewritten Tranquility, Bloom, Wither, Revitalize and Shank.

Data from ForeverDB.net
